en.askingHoldMsHint: Minimum visibility of the asking icon before it settles.
en.colorsHint: Click a chip to pick that color — the hex value lives in the picker. Only the colors this effect uses are listed.
en.defaultColorHint: Color of the idle whale — idle paints one color and never animates, so this is its only setting. Give each DSH instance a different value to tell their browser tabs apart; blank falls back to the idle state's own color.
en.defaultColorWarn: Too close to the {state} color {color} (ΔE {de}) — the two are easy to confuse at tab size.
en.defaultColorWarnRainbow: The {state} state uses the rainbow effect, which sweeps every hue — any colored default will collide with it at some phase.
en.description: How the browser tab favicon reflects session state.
en.doneHoldMsHint: How long the done icon stays before returning to idle.
en.invalidColors: Enter hex colors like #FACC15, separated by commas.
en.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
en.rainbowHint: The rainbow effect sweeps every hue; the chip beside the wheel only sets its starting hue.
en.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
en.speedHint: Per-state cycle length; blank falls back to the built-in default for that effect. Static states have no cycle.
en.statesHint: Detailed configuration for the states that animate or carry a signal. Idle is not listed: it uses the default icon color above.
en.title: Favicon indicator
